drinks.name: Coors Light
drinks.description: Light, lager beer, known for its crisp, clean and refreshing taste.
drinks.extended_description: This is a really long blurb about why Coors Light changed my life. When I was at the young age of 2 (trimesters old), my mother shared the joy with me that is a nice, fresh Coors Light. Together, through my mother's body I felt the soothing taste of Coors Light. Some may call it fetal alchohol syndrome, but I call it basic maternal love.
